title: Design System: 卫戍协议助手

motion.name: portrait-state
motion.purpose: In-place Ban feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: button-primary
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font:14px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; padding:8px 18px; border:1px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); border-radius:4px; background:var(--accent,#465e3d); color:#fff; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:#334c2a; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: button-quiet
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { font:13px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; min-height:36px; padding:5px 10px; border:1px solid var(--line,#d6dbd0); border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--ink,#252b26); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--danger,#9b3540); color:var(--danger,#9b3540); background:var(--danger-soft,#f8e9e9); } .ds-button-quiet:disabled { color:#747c70; background:#f7f8f5; cursor:default; } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: button-reset
components.css: .ds-button-reset { font:12px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; min-height:34px; padding:4px 0 4px 12px; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--accent,#465e3d); cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-reset:hover:not(:disabled) { text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-reset:disabled { color:#747c70; cursor:default; } .ds-button-reset:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: covenant-select
components.description: Native covenant selector; no text input exists.
components.css: .ds-covenant-select { font:13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; height:34px; min-width:148px; padding:4px 30px 4px 10px; background:var(--surface,#fff); color:var(--ink,#252b26); border:1px solid #adb7a5; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-covenant-select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: status-filter
components.css: .ds-status-filter { position:relative; font:14px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; min-height:43px; padding:6px 2px 12px; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--muted,#636b60); cursor:pointer; } .ds-status-filter:hover { color:var(--ink,#252b26); } .ds-status-filter[aria-pressed=true] { color:var(--accent,#465e3d); font-weight:650; } .ds-status-filter[aria-pressed=true]::after { content:""; position:absolute; height:2px; bottom:-1px; left:0; right:0; background:currentColor; } .ds-status-filter span { padding:0 6px; border-radius:3px; font-size:12px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; background:var(--accent,#465e3d); color:#fff; } .ds-status-filter:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: status-chip
components.css: .ds-status-chip { font:600 11px/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--warning-soft,#fbf1d9); color:var(--warning,#815c18); }

components.name: operator-card
components.description: Desktop geometry sample; preview omits the local portrait, not replaced by invented imagery.
components.html:
可用

折桠

乌萨斯 不屈

核心盟约可用
components.css: .ds-operator-card { width:156px; border:1px solid var(--line,#d6dbd0); border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface,#fff); overflow:hidden; font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#252b26); } .ds-portrait { position:relative; aspect-ratio:1.25; background:#e7e9e3; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d6dbd0); } .ds-status { position:absolute; right:5px; bottom:5px; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:2px; background:#f2f6ed; color:#405735; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .ds-info { padding:9px 10px 11px; } .ds-info h3 { margin:0; min-height:22px; font-size:14px; font-weight:650; line-height:1.4; } .ds-covenants { min-height:36px; font-size:11px; line-height:1.6; color:var(--muted,#636b60); } .ds-reason { margin:4px 0 0; min-height:40px; padding-top:4px; border-top:1px solid var(--line,#d6dbd0); font-size:11px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--muted,#636b60); }

components.name: Covenant Ban
components.description: Selected Ban state; compact preview omits the decorative covenant logo.
components.css: .ds-ban { position: relative; min-height: 43px; padding: 5px 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line,#d6dbd0); border-radius: 3px; background: #f8f9f6; text-align: left; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-ban:hover { background: var(--surface-soft,#eef1e8); border-color: #85957a; } .ds-ban[aria-pressed='true'] { color: var(--danger,#9b3540); background: var(--danger-soft,#f8e9e9); border-color: #bc747b; } .ds-ban[aria-pressed='true'] > span { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-ban { min-height: 44px; padding: 4px; gap: 4px; font-size: 11px; } .ds-ban { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#252b26); cursor:pointer; } .ds-ban:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#465e3d); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: A compact Chinese operator catalog on pale gray-green paper. Real portraits carry recognition; fine rules and concise metadata support comparison. Desktop is primary, with a vertically stacked mobile layout. Ban feedback stays on the existing cards rather than becoming a separate results screen.
keyCharacteristics: Olive selection, muted red bans, amber uncertainty.
Stable portrait geometry with explicit status and reasons.

rules.name: The Explicit State Rule
rules.body: Color always accompanies a written status; banned covenant names also receive a strike-through.

dos: Do preserve real portraits, written status and a reason area on every card.
Do distinguish ordinary selection from Ban; retain amber for pending verification.
Do retain keyboard focus, semantic controls and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't change portrait dimensions or move pending-verification operators into the banned group.
Don't communicate a ruling through grayscale or color alone.
Don't present PRTS-ambiguous mixed cases as confirmed available or banned.
